indicator: Claim soon after the policy started
applies_when: Incident is 1 to 30 days after the policy start
published_basis: IVASS indicator CON1: a claim in the days after inception
scale_note: Project points for this demo, so the ten rules can be added up. They are not the official IVASS indicator scores. IVASS classifies its own 22-indicator total as none at 0, low at 1-19, medium at 20-49 and high above 49. This demo uses green 0-14, amber 15-34 and red 35 or more.
